answer: Shake the vine. Each epoch the network hands a few random keys a harmless fault, such as a task whose deadline shifts mid-voyage. Independent agents stumble and recover at their own pace. Keys cut from the same timber, one operator's scheduler and model queue, recover in lockstep, seconds apart, with matching retry patterns. Keys whose recovery timing keeps correlating across many shakes are treated as one identity and share one reward. (Thresholds would need tuning.)
